Wei Okoro
wei.okoro@example.com | Atlanta, GA
Wei Okoro has 4 years of experience in design. Most recently, Product Designer
at Sagebrook Agency (2024-2026), where they built and maintained the company's
design system components and guidelines. Before that, Junior Product Designer
at Sagebrook Brands (2022-2024). Education: B.S. Graphic Design, University of
Texas at Dallas, 2022. Core skills: Wireframing, Design systems, Visual design,
UX research, Prototyping.
